description.value: Signature Indian Cuisine is a sit-down Indian restaurant in Courtenay on Vancouver Island, offering a broad menu of traditional and contemporary dishes including tandoori specialties from a clay oven, exotic curries, biryanis, and a full vegetarian section. The kitchen emphasises fresh ingredients, authentic spices, and time-honoured cooking methods with a contemporary Indian twist. Catering for special occasions is also available.
